title: Gender disparities in research trial leadership within oral and maxillofacial surgery
html: Gender disparities in research trial leadership have been reported in nearly every medical specialty. The true extent of women’s involvement as principal investigators (PIs) in oral and maxillofacial surgery (OMS) research trials remains unknown. The current study aims to address this knowledge gap through analyzing relevant trials registered on ClinicalTrials.gov in the 21st century. A validated search strategy, comprising procedure names and field-specific terms, was utilized to identify OMS research trials.
